name: Smart Translate
description: Detects source language and translates on-device with managed offline language models. Link asks before downloading missing models and lets users keep or remove downloaded languages.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: Google ML Kit Translation and Language Identification APIs

release_notes: Requests and waits for the Google Play services Language ID optional module; requires explicit user confirmation before downloading missing translation language models; provides in-app keep/remove controls; caches LanguageIdentifier and Translator clients to reduce repeated setup and translation latency.
